payload.title: Correct JSON list member lookup for missing/null and compatible array queries
payload.summary: P2 public JsonListFile.find_by returns an item with no requested member when querying None and fails compatible list/nested-array queries because stored arrays are frozen tuples. On main 26bd8053ab8ad8323dd3273b4b0e986de05388e9 parse [{"tag":"missing"},{"tag":"present","key":null}] and query key=None: tag missing is returned, expected present. A key:[1,2] item queried using [1,2] incorrectly returns None. Repair actual member-presence and compatible JSON comparison within existing model ownership; retain first-match order, null semantics, immutability and source provenance.

discovery.reference: audit:filesystem-codecs-models:26bd8053:20261026:literal public codec and ToolRunner rich-file probes

payload.benefit: Reliable public structured lookup without falsely claiming absent JSON members match null or losing compatible array matches.
payload.uncertainty: No production autonomous coding action or existing native find_by caller was demonstrated. Generic Tool read returns the affected rich model; this is public API correctness, not authorization or SourceObservation failure.
